title: Structure record
description: One deposited structure, joined from GPCRdb and RCSB. The two sources are never merged into a single field: where they disagree, both are kept and the record is flagged.

gpcrdb_structure_record.description: The GPCRdb record verbatim, including its raw ligand and signalling protein annotations. Raw means raw: not normalised in Phase 1.

receptor_chain.description: GPCRdb preferred chain; not re-derived here.

experimental_method.description: Full wwPDB controlled vocabulary from exptl[].method.

experimental_method_abbrev.description: RCSB abbreviation ('EM', 'X-ray'). Kept because it is a different vocabulary, not a synonym.

nominal_resolution.description: As reported. No cutoff is applied in Phase 1.

transducer_observed_in_structure_raw.description: The GPCRdb signalling-protein annotation verbatim. For complexes it is an object keyed by entity, e.g. {'data': {'entity1': {'chain': 'D', 'entry_name': 'gnas2_human'}}, 'type': 'G protein'}. It is a structural observation, NOT a pathway claim, and is left un-normalised in Phase 1 (config/transducer_classes.json: normalised_in_phase_1 = false).

functional_pathway_evidence.description: Reserved. Functional evidence is out of Phase 1 scope and must stay null; it may never be inferred from the structural annotation.

pdb_status.description: wwPDB status code, e.g. REL, OBS, WDRN.

replacement_pdb_ids.description: Populated only when the entry is superseded.

qc_flags.description: Values must exist in config/qc_flags.json. A flag describes a record; it never removes it from the raw universe.

unresolved.description: True when a join could not be completed. Still part of the universe.
